notes: Form N-14 registration statement (MainStay Funds) for the reorganization of MainStay Epoch U.S. All Cap Fund into MainStay WMC Enduring Capital Fund (the acquiring fund). Both are open-end mutual funds, so fund_type is open_end_fund and security_class is recorded as other (open-end fund shares, not common stock). The filing states no shareholder vote is required. A second reorganization, MainStay MacKay U.S. Equity Opportunities Fund into the same acquiring fund, is also described with the same expected date; it is not recorded as a separate event or as a target here, so n_targets is 1 for the Epoch reorganization. Exchange basis is nav_for_nav as stated (aggregate NAV equal). The filing gives no exchange ratio, cash per share, collar, termination date, meeting date or record date in the excerpt, so those are null. The fund's cover-page dates are 'March __, 2021' and the reorganization is stated to be expected on or about April 26, 2021. Conditions are the Reorganization Agreement conditions in the excerpt; the dividend-declaration condition is not an enum category and is not recorded.
